thesis_summary.thesis: Abbott Laboratories is a diversified global healthcare company selling branded generic drugs in emerging markets, infant and adult nutrition, laboratory and rapid diagnostics, and medical devices. **[Fact]** Customers are hospitals, labs, pharmacies, and consumers across more than 160 countries. **[Fact]** FY2025 net sales were **$44.3 billion** on four reportable segments: Established Pharmaceutical Products (**$5.5 billion**), Nutritional Products (**$8.5 billion**), Diagnostic Products (**$8.9 billion**), and Medical Devices (**$21.4 billion**). **[Fact]** Cash from operations was **$9.57 billion** and capital spending **$2.17 billion**, yielding about **$4.23** of free cash flow per diluted share. **[Inference]** Abbott is a wide-moat healthcare compounder whose economics are anchored in installed medical devices and recurring diagnostics/nutrition consumption, not one-time drug patents alone.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: There is **no clear dated mispricing signal** (HK predictive attribute: **none**). **[Inference]** The stock may embed fear of post-COVID diagnostics normalization and Q1 2026 margin compression while under-crediting durable device growth (continuous glucose monitoring, structural heart). Return at today's price is **normalized owner cash flow**, not a catalyst with a single payoff date. Peer comparison (Medtronic, Danaher diagnostics, Dexcom in CGM) frames whether Libre-led growth is already fully priced.
